import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('/Users/yanggang/workspace/github.com/teatak/pudding-core')
metadata = root / 'docs/validation/summarize-results-checkpoint-run-metadata-2026-10-19.json'
data = json.loads(metadata.read_text())

def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

assert data['status'] == 'tests-passed-ready'
assert digest(data['baselineBinary']) == data['baselineBinarySHA256']
assert digest(data['candidateBinary']) == data['candidateBinarySHA256']
for run in data['plannedRuns']:
    assert digest(root / run['manifest']) == run['manifestSHA256']
    assert not (root / run['output']).exists()
    assert not Path(run['log']).exists()

data['status'] = 'running'
data['runnerSource'] = Path(__file__).read_text()
data['runnerSHA256'] = digest(__file__)
data['outcomes'] = []
metadata.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
for index, run in enumerate(data['plannedRuns'], 1):
    binary = data['baselineBinary' if run['arm'] == 'base' else 'candidateBinary']
    command = [binary, '-repository-tasks', run['manifest'], '-benchmark-arm', 'memo',
               '-provider', 'DeepSeek', '-model', 'deepseek-flash', '-protocol', 'openai-compatible',
               '-max-requests', '24', '-output', run['output']]
    print(f"{index}/8 {run['arm']} {run['taskID']} started", flush=True)
    with Path(run['log']).open('x') as log:
        code = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).returncode
    outcome = {**run, 'command': command, 'exitCode': code,
               'completedAt': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
               'logSHA256': digest(run['log'])}
    if (root / run['output']).exists():
        outcome['reportSHA256'] = digest(root / run['output'])
        report = json.loads((root / run['output']).read_text())
        if report.get('runs'):
            result = report['runs'][0]
            print(f"{index}/8 done exit={code} attempts={result['memoAttempts']} invalid={result['invalidMemos']} "
                  f"released={result['applied']} checks={result['main']['checksPassed']}/{result['main']['checksTotal']} "
                  f"followup={result['followup']['correct']}", flush=True)
    data['outcomes'].append(outcome)
    metadata.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
data['status'] = 'runs-completed'
metadata.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
raise SystemExit(any(item['exitCode'] != 0 for item in data['outcomes']))
